## SIERRA Ventures' 20th Annual CXO Summit

SIERRA Ventures' 20th Annual CXO Summit brought together industry thought leaders from our CXO Advisory Board and EPL Council, as well as entrepreneurs from our portfolio. Bill McDermott, CEO of ServiceNow, keynoted the summit, sharing lessons in leadership and the future of the enterprise. Deep dives with the [CEO of LinkedIn](https://www.sierraventures.com/ascend/ryan-roslansky-ceo-of-linkedin-and-evp-at-microsoft?hsLang=en), the EVP of Product atSnowflake, the CBO ofPerplexity, the CTO/Co-Founder of Reflection AI, and the Co-Founder of Glean provided the audience with insights from cutting-edge companies on the problems facing enterprises in AI, cybersecurity, data, and more.

[Learn more](https://www.sierraventures.com/)

### Great entrepreneurs deserve more than just capital.

Every member of the Sierra Ventures team is dedicated to helping our entrepreneurs succeed.

Our Managing Partners have years of experience growing businesses of all sizes, not just as investors but as entrepreneurs and operational executives in charge of engineering, finance, marketing, and operations. The seasoned leaders on our Operating Team provide high-touch support through business development, strategy, and partner relations and are always finding opportunities to help our portfolio companies grow and scale.
